Modern museum shorthand can credit his breakthrough, but this collapses prior sea timekeepers, H4 watch terminology, later developed chronometer mechanisms and a wider navigation system. Prefer H4 helped demonstrate watch-based longitude timekeeping; no exclusive first-ever invention claim is proposed.
